description: Changes files on the Mac. action: write (path, text; an existing file only with overwrite), append (path, text: added at the end), edit (path, find: an exact passage that appears once, text: its replacement), create_folder (path), move or copy (path, to: the new path or a folder to put it in; never replaces an existing file), trash (path: moves it to the Trash, where it can be put back).

find.description: For edit: the exact passage to replace

machine.description: The machine to use, by name, as the machines tool lists it. Leave it out when only one machine offers this tool.

overwrite.description: For write: replace an existing file

text.description: The text to write, add, or put in place of find

to.description: For move and copy: where to

name: files_change
title: Change Files
